note: C5: all writes require the session actor, exact Origin, JSON and CSRF. IDs in responses are server-generated. Dates are optional and savings may exceed the target if spendable funds allow.

create.note: Goal and initial movement commit together. Reusing the same key/payload returns the original receipt; a changed payload returns 409 REQUEST_KEY_REUSED.

contribution.note: Reserves under B4's account lock. Failed reservation writes neither a movement nor a new saved amount.

withdrawal.note: Releases exactly 2000 reserved cents without a provider transfer. Cannot exceed durable savings.
